instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep a short summary of this conversation, so the next AI that opens it reads a few lines instead of every message", and give it conversation_id (The conversation's id, as the messages it is in show it); summary (The summary, in a few lines); latest (The conversation's newest message now: its id and time).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-a-thread-summary and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give conversation_id (and app), summary (at most 4000 characters) and latest: { id, at } of the conversation's newest message now, as the messages owner shows it (its newest message from reading the conversation).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: thread-summary (records:read, records:list, records:write).
